This computer stops backing up to this drive and forgets its saved passphrase. The backups on the drive are kept, and other computers can keep using it. This works even if the drive is lost or broken.

Handing the drive over to someone else? Also delete any copies of the backed-up files that should not stay on this computer.

recovery_note:
Aegis drive details

This note says where your backup is on your Aegis USB drive. It contains no passphrase.

To get your files back on any computer:
1) Plug in the Aegis drive.
2) Open the AEGIS-RESTORE folder on the drive and follow {{readme}} (or install Aegis and use Restore).
3) Type your passphrase when asked.

If you chose "Ask for my passphrase every time", the passphrase is stored nowhere: keep your written copy safe.

For technical help: recovery.json next to this file lists the backup's location on the drive.
